notes.title: Update
notes.notes: Hello munchers! We apologize for the silence over the past couple years. With major changes to the engine we were using and life events, we have been unable to do much work on "The After Levels". We are currently strategizing on the best way forward. We deeply appreciate your patience, understanding and support!

notes.title: Free Content Update coming soon!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Munchers![/b]
To show my appreciate for all of you, there will be a free content update for Earth Muncher!! There will be plenty more levels, some new baddies, new obstacles, and treasures that await Norm. 

Stay tuned for more info!

notes.title: The Earth thanks you!
notes.notes:
Props all around to those who purchased Earth Muncher during our launch, we donated 20% of all sales! We made a donation to the Earth Day Network and look forward to our future with the community!

Thank you all for your support!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32257793/7f4ce3bbabecea555c5c9ced70c0e2fd777ba24a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Full screen and window resizing added!
notes.notes: You asked, we delivered! You can now resize the window or go full screen.

notes.title: Earth Day 2018
notes.notes:
Earth Day is a day that we come together to appreciate the Earth and its’ treasures. This Earth Day, celebrate it with Norm the Earthworm and nom said treasures!
